AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Job AUD-SOL-P12-117, agent 117. Independent T4 payment-contract and piece-boundary audit; no candidate-source edits.

### Prior findings / G09 applicability

Every P1 file is byte-identical to the original's Sol-approved `78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1`; that prior evidence applies to unchanged routing, request shape, terms arithmetic, memory-only secrets and wallet-default behavior, but **not** to compatibility with the now-changed backend error contract. All nine piece files and their consumers were independently read; this is not a copied approval. ([Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [exact P1 tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385), [current recurring error contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-errors.ts))

Original B-334-3/4's native-result classification and pre-sheet amount/cadence/trial reconciliation remain present, and `mode:none` remains accepted; original C-334-3 is the P2 poll-helper delta, not a P1 change. ([Prior closure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [current parser](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L163-L253), [current reconciliation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/planTerms.ts#L324-L385))

### B-342-1 — current backend uncertainty is converted into a proven no-charge claim

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:512–513,556–559,728–738,783–787,853–868,880–889`. Current backend #679 deliberately uses `PAYMENT_RETRY`, `STRIPE_CHECKOUT_ERROR` and `SUBSCRIPTION_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE` for results it cannot prove unpaid; the mobile mapper ignores that distinction and says “nothing was charged,” including the unknown-500 fallback. ([Mobile mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L717-L889), [backend's explicit B-679-6 uncertainty contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-errors.ts#L115-L162))

**Counterexample:** a previous native confirmation loses its response; a same-key retry cannot retrieve/retire its Stripe subscription and returns one of those coded failures, while the prior payment may have committed. The actual mapper's three coded cases plus unknown 500 each fail the truthful-outcome assertion in the independent CI lane. ([Retry/read boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-checkout.service.ts#L1134-L1161), [four executed counterexamples](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221))

**Minimal fix rule:** do not derive no-charge from an unknown HTTP result or these codes alone; use outcome-unknown copy, a short reference and support/reconciliation next action, preserving the same attempt. Only an explicit authoritative unpaid/closed result permits a categorical no-charge statement. Verify all four probes fail before/pass after, and retain the definitive-refusal control.

### B-342-2 — finished one-time replay dispositions are unmapped

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:749–889` (missing cases; default `:880–889`). Current #661's `PAYMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETE`, `PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_CLOSED` and `PAYMENT_REFUNDED_OR_IN_REVIEW` all fall to “The payment did not go through and nothing was charged,” which is false for an already-paid or refunded/review purchase and does not provide the specified disposition. ([Mobile default](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L880-L889), [current replay classifier and messages](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6fdc35de61a26a0c9e8b3741044a3ec223dc9ab4/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L87-L154))

**Counterexample:** replay a finished key after a paid response was lost; the server returns `PAYMENT_ALREADY_COMPLETE`, but the mapper asserts payment failure/no charge. All three exact-contract mapper probes fail; P2 separately owns the dead-key/action continuation. ([Three executed replay cases](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221), [P2 catch boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L710-L748))

**Minimal fix rule:** map all three codes specifically: completed → open/reconcile the existing plan; closed → actionable fresh-checkout guidance; refunded/review → status/support guidance without a fresh charge or no-charge claim. Carry machine-readable action semantics for P2, and pin each code with the actual backend envelope.

### C-342-1 — optional unknown-diagnostic allowlist hardening

**File:line:** `src/lib/packagePayment.ts:635–644,652–659,880–888`. An arbitrary unknown response `code`/`error` is copied into Sentry extras and normalized into exception/cause text; a synthetic email/free-form-note canary survives both real global event-scrub passes, although no current backend PII-emitting code path was demonstrated, so this is defense-in-depth C rather than an asserted production disclosure. ([Diagnostic construction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L625-L659), [executed scrub-boundary canary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221))

**Minimal fix rule:** allowlist bounded backend/native machine labels and use a constant unknown label; never incorporate unknown strings into error messages, causes or extras. Verify the canary disappears while known codes and references remain.

### Exact-head execution / landing boundary

Independent test-only commit `cf91d1b` has an empty candidate runtime/config/dependency delta: **8 probe failures / 7 passing controls**, including six wallet controls and the definitive-refusal control; the nonexistent requested `clientPaymentsApi.test.ts` selector did not execute and is not evidence. Exact-head ordinary CI passes **449 suites / 6,283 tests**, and Typecheck/lint/test plus both required CodeQL analyses are successful. ([Independent run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179727433/job/111369664221), [ordinary full execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152688718/job/111289624734), [exact-head CodeQL analyses](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152688697))

P1 adds no hook/screen imports from later pieces and stays under the size gate; land the payment stack as one only after the backend recurring chain is approved/deployed, retaining the original native-card-update composition condition in the final P3 tree. No native-provider/device or production acceptance is claimed. ([P1 split/readiness assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/342#issuecomment-5975774150), [original composition condition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092))
